description: A two-face tower rescue with ladders, marked fires and a limited extinguisher stock.

metadata.source_notes: TRP-708 supplies the two-face tower, eye inspection, edge face changes, arrow-key movement, direction-dependent extinguishing, and one-use stock. The tower geometry, rescue maps, procedural generation, visuals, interaction pair and replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: Baseline assignment is L4/full. The route requires maintaining two non-simultaneous face maps, selecting ladder seams, and choosing a passage whose fire cost fits four extinguishers; this is a scripted implementation candidate, not a human or agent calibration result.

name: Firewatch Fold
natural_language: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to inspect both faces, cross seams deliberately, and use Shift only when opening a fire on your chosen route.
